title: AzL Sonar event feed (recording format 1)
description: One JSON object per line (UTF-8, JSON Lines). The same lines are what Sonar records with -Record and what -Replay plays back, so any tool that appends valid lines to a .jsonl file can be followed or replayed by Sonar. Every line has t (UTC time the event was seen) and k (kind). The first valid line of a file must be a session event. Lines that are not valid JSON objects with t and k are skipped and counted; an unknown kind is ignored (an extension point: a producer may add its own kinds, replay shows only the kinds below). State events come as a keyframe (full) or a delta (ops); a delta before the first keyframe of its session is skipped.

t.description: UTC time of the event, ISO 8601 with Z, for example 2026-10-11T08:00:01.000Z. Never goes backwards inside a file.

k.description: Event kind. Known kinds: session, state, tailer, log, end.

session.title: session: one per Sonar (or producer) start; appending a new session to an existing file is allowed

format.description: Recording format. A reader refuses a format newer than it knows.

tool.description: Producer name, for example AzL Sonar.

config.description: The public config (no addresses, secret names or secrets): clusterName, cluster, resourceGroup, identityModel, provisioningRoute, nodes[{name, seed}], logs.paths, pollSeconds, startedAt, serverId.

guidance.description: The per-phase log-access guidance the page shows (data/phase-guidance.json).

stateFull.title: state, keyframe: the whole state the page shows

stateDelta.title: state, delta: ops that turn the previous state into the next

oneOf.description: set: object key, or array index (index = length appends)
delete an object key (or array item by index)
truncate the array at path to a length

path.description: Object keys (strings) and array indexes (integers) from the root of the state.

deploymentState.description: What /api/state returns. Only the fields below are read by the page; a producer fills what it knows. Step trees are arrays of { id, name, description, status, rawStatus, start, end, durationSeconds, errors[], children[] }; status is one of notstarted, running, success, error, skipped, unknown.

mode.description: Validate or Deploy, as Azure reports it.

phase.description: provisioning, arc-registration, validation, deployment, post-deployment, done or failed.

update.description: The Update view. Azure's track when Azure reports a run; otherwise, with the toolkit's update-events.jsonl, an object with source 'events', verified false, status, phase, level, label, tree and counts.

updateEvents.description: What the toolkit's update-events.jsonl says (Auto and Update monitors); null for the other monitors.

verification.description: The Verification view: the pre-cluster gate's run (status, verdict, counts, categories) and, beside it, the gate's Plan from precluster-plan-events.jsonl.

toolkitEvent.title: toolkit feed event: one line of update-events.jsonl or precluster-plan-events.jsonl in the shared events folder (the envelope every azurelocal-toolkit feed shares)
toolkitEvent.description: JSON Lines, UTF-8 without BOM, appended by the toolkit and read by Sonar (read only, shared with the writer). These files are Sonar's INPUT from the toolkit, not Sonar's recording: they have no t or k. update-events.jsonl (stage SolutionUpdate; Get-AvailableSolutionUpdate.ps1 with mode Check, Start-AzureLocalSolutionUpdate.ps1 with mode WhatIf or Install): RunStarted (step Run), EnvironmentRead (step Environment), DiscoveryPolled (step Discovery), one Update<Next> or UpdateAttention line per update (step Update, with updateName and version), EnvironmentAttention, then RunCompleted or RunFailed (step Run, exitCode, verdict). precluster-plan-events.jsonl (stage PreClusterVerification, mode Plan; Invoke-AzureLocalPreClusterVerification.ps1 -Mode Plan): RunStarted (step Run), one CategoryPlanned per category (step azure, identity, nodes, network, storage or readiness; applies, total, blocking), RunCompleted (step Run, exitCode 0, result Planned). A plan has no verdict. A line that is not a JSON object with node and state is skipped; another stage is ignored.

timestamp.description: UTC, round trip format with up to seven fractional digits.

node.description: '*' for the run itself, else a machine name.

stage.description: SolutionUpdate for update-events.jsonl, PreClusterVerification for precluster-plan-events.jsonl.

step.description: Run for the run's own lines, else the stage of the run: Environment, Discovery, Update (update feed); the category id (plan feed).

state.description: RunStarted, RunCompleted, RunFailed, or the event: EnvironmentRead, DiscoveryPolled, UpdateStart, UpdateFollow, UpdateImportSbe, UpdateAttention, UpdateWouldStart, UpdateStarted, UpdatePrepared, CategoryPlanned ... Sonar does not depend on a fixed list.

evidence.description: What happened, in words (at most 4000 characters).

runId.description: One per run; a RunStarted with another runId starts the view over.

mode.description: Check, WhatIf or Install (update feed); Plan (plan feed).

exitCode.description: On the closing line: 0 done, 1 failed, 2 an input problem.

result.description: Running, Passed, Warning, Failed, Skipped or Planned.

verdict.description: Update feed, closing line of a Check: UpToDate, UpdateAvailable, AdditionalContentRequired, UpdateRunning or AttentionNeeded. The plan feed has none.

updateEventsState.description: state.updateEvents: the run of update-events.jsonl as Sonar read it.

plan.description: True for a Check, Plan or WhatIf run: nothing was installed.

verificationPlan.description: state.verification.plan: the pre-cluster gate's Plan (precluster-plan-events.jsonl). Informational: it has no verdict and is never a Fail; the gate's own run, when there is one, is the answer.

tailer.title: tailer: the status of the log reader

toolkitEvent.title: toolkit feed event: one line of update-events.jsonl or precluster-plan-events.jsonl in the shared events folder (the envelope every azurelocal-toolkit feed shares)

log.title: log: new log lines, in order

seq.description: Increases by one per line inside a session.

time.description: Time the line was written (node UTC offset applied).

lost.description: Lines dropped before they were recorded.

unknownKind.title: any other kind: skipped by the reader (extension point for other tools)
